steps.path: Sign-in, at six window sizes from a big monitor to phone width
steps.headline: Setup now fits every window: the logo and spacing shrink with the window, so the choices stay on screen.
steps.changed: The name grows to 88px on a normal window and shrinks to 44px on a small one. Short windows (720px tall and under) get less space above and below the logo. On a narrow window the 'No extra cost' labels wait for the second page and the heading steps down a size. The browser sign-in page scales the same way.
steps.notice: Down to 800×600 everything fits without scrolling. At 640×480 the third choice scrolls into view (three cards can't fit that height).
steps.risk: On a 1920×1080 monitor setup looks small and airy, since it stops growing at 88px.

steps.path: Sign-in's second page, at the same six sizes
steps.headline: One kind opened, at every size.
steps.changed: Same scaling; the buttons stay full width of the card.
steps.notice: At 640×480 the API key button needs a short scroll.

steps.path: The failure card, at the same six sizes
steps.headline: The failure card at every size.
steps.changed: Fits without scrolling at all six.
